llm.summary: This is a Vedic astrology analysis skill that may use sensitive chart and life details and create local report files, but the behavior is disclosed and fits its stated purpose.

dimensions.detail: The skill coherently supports Chinese Vedic/Jyotish chart analysis using topic references and local helper scripts for chart validation and HTML report rendering; inputs can include sensitive birth, relationship, career, and life-event data.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Routing is purpose-aligned and tells the agent to use only relevant references, but the trigger wording is broad around career, marriage, cities, and timing, so users should invoke it intentionally for astrology-related requests.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains markdown references and local Python scripts only; metadata and inspected scripts show no package install flow, declared dependencies, credential setup, network calls, or auto-start behavior.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Reading user-provided PDFs, screenshots, markdown exports, or text chart data is proportionate for chart analysis, but those files may contain private personal details.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: For report-scale work, the skill instructs the agent to create local report metadata, section markdown files, and report.html; this is disclosed and local, but users should be aware that sensitive reports may remain on disk.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable sharing sensitive birth/chart details and life history with the agent. Prefer redacted or minimal inputs when possible, and review or delete generated report folders when finished.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: The broad trigger concern is partly supported by the description, but the surrounding instructions consistently route to astrology/Jyotish analysis and do not add unrelated authority.
[SQP-2] expected: The skill does request chart files and relationship-related inputs, which can be sensitive, but this is directly tied to the stated marriage-analysis purpose; the main gap is privacy guidance, not hidden collection or exfiltration.
[SQP-3] expected: The workflow is Chinese-focused, matching the skill name and description; this may limit informed use by non-Chinese users but is not evidence of unsafe behavior.
[SQP-2] expected: The report.html generation concern is supported, but file creation is local, described in the artifacts, gated for full reports, and handled by a narrow renderer script with no network behavior.
[SQP-2] expected: Default report generation creates durable local artifacts, but it is coherent with a report-building skill and does not show destructive actions, credential use, or data export.
